reason: Enables access to the DSH Web GUI from other LAN devices by binding the server to 0.0.0.0 and injecting a crypto.randomUUID polyfill; the README states that access is unauthenticated and can expose command-execution capability, warranting human review.

summaries.zh: 将 DSH Web GUI 绑定到局域网地址，并为明文 HTTP 访问注入 crypto.randomUUID 兼容实现。
summaries.en: Binds the DSH Web GUI for LAN access and injects a crypto.randomUUID compatibility implementation for plaintext HTTP contexts.

capabilities: Binds the Web GUI server to 0.0.0.0 for LAN access
Injects a crypto.randomUUID polyfill into served index.html responses
Allows remote devices on the same network to access supported DSH GUI functions
